Name: Stardew Timelapse
Author: evskii
Description:
This mod automatically creates an animated GIF timelapse of your farm every single day. This mod requires no user input and runs automatically as you play the game. Generating the GIF runs asynchronously alongside your game as to not increase loading times.

[b]Things To Note:[/b]
[list]
[*]You must leave your house everyday to trigger the screenshot.
[*]The longer your game is, the larger the GIF becomes [This in turn increases the amount of time needed for the GIF to generate]
[*]This mod has been tested, but that does not mean it's bug free. Please report any bugs you encounter so they can be modified.
[*][color=#ff0000][b]Farms that share the same name will cause conflicts and their GIFs will overwrite one another.[/b][/color]
[/list]
[b]Plans:[/b]
This mod is quite primitive at the moment, however I thought I would try to get some eyes on it early so I can use the feedback gained to make changes. There are a few things already planned for the future.
[list]
[*]Store the GIF and screenshots used in a specific folder based off of which save you are playing.
[*]Modify the GIF generation so that 1) all screenshots don't have to be kept and 2) that only the newest frame needs calculation, and not the entire GIF.
[*]Create a config file/UI so that things like frame delays and quality settings can be modified.
[/list]
